name: Fractured Realms
detailed_description:
What is Fractured Realms?:

Fractured Realms is a UI-driven, idle-style RPG that blends classic fantasy progression with strategic base-building. Drawing inspiration from Old School RuneScape, Melvor Idle, and the structured upgrade systems of Clash of Clans, this game offers a fresh take on skill-based progression and world-building — all without traditional character movement.

Rather than controlling a character in a world, you'll interact entirely through a rich user interface. From training RPG skills like Mining, Woodcutting, and Smithing to constructing your own central outpost, the entire experience is built around resource mastery, goal-setting, and long-term progression.

Your outpost is more than just a home — it's the core of your journey. As you gather resources and meet skill requirements, you’ll unlock new buildings, upgrades, and regions. Every choice you make strengthens your foundation, fuels your progress, and expands your influence across the realms.

Whether you're playing actively or checking in throughout the day, Fractured Realms is designed to be rewarding, strategic, and deeply satisfying — for both casual players and longtime RPG veterans.

Features:

Fractured Realms takes inspiration from the time-tested RPG formulas of RuneScape, the minimalism of Melvor Idle, and the base development elements of Clash of Clans — but we’ve built on those foundations to craft a game with its own identity, pacing, and depth.

Core Features:

  • Build Your Outpost
    Construct and upgrade a central base that serves as your staging ground. Unlock new buildings, enhance production, and meet level requirements to expand your reach into the world.

  • Train Classic RPG Skills
    Master a growing list of skills including Mining, Smithing, Woodcutting, Fishing, Cooking, and more. Each skill has its own progression path, requirements, and reward structures.

  • Progress Through Milestones
    Start in a small region and unlock new areas, resources, and systems as you level up. There’s always something just around the corner to strive for.

  • Gather, Craft, and Optimize
    Everything you collect has value — from basic logs to rare ores and enchanted items. Turn raw materials into valuable goods, manage inventories, and craft gear that powers future progress.

  • Minimalist Pixel Art
    Designed in a detailed 32x32 style, every icon and interface element is handcrafted to be clean, expressive, and nostalgic. It feels classic, but refined.

  • Built for All Playstyles
    You can play actively and min-max your upgrades — or let your skills run in the background while you do other things. It's your pace, your path.

No predatory mechanics. No energy systems. Just pure, idle-friendly RPG progression.

Explore, Expand & Excel:

Your journey begins in a small corner of the fractured realms — a land scarred by ancient magic, scattered with ruins and opportunity. As you grow your outpost and develop your skills, you'll unlock new resources, expand into fresh areas, and uncover lore and secrets that slowly bring the world back to life.

Progression is structured but flexible — players follow a general path of unlocking buildings and skills, but how you prioritize your upgrades, what you train first, and how you manage your economy is entirely up to you. There’s always something to aim for, whether it's the next skill milestone, outpost tier, or rare material.

You’ll start small, but over time, Fractured Realms evolves into a sprawling RPG sandbox filled with interlinked systems and player-driven goals.

  • Processor: Dual-core CPU, 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 10
